name: CFTC Commitments of Traders
rate_limits: The CFTC says it is "not providing tokens to use the Public Reporting APIs" and access works without one if use is reasonable.
history_start: Unverified here; compressed history files on the CFTC site go back decades.
what_it_has: Weekly open interest and long and short positions by trader type for US futures, including the CME currency futures (EUR, JPY, GBP and others). Socrata dataset r4w3-av2u, plus plain text files.
simple: Every week the US futures regulator shows who is betting on each currency going up or down.
license_terms: Legacy futures-only report (Socrata dataset 6dca-aqww), 1986 on, fetched by parity since 2026-10-22. US federal government data; the CFTC asks for acknowledgement (https://www.cftc.gov/WebPolicy/index.htm).
quality_notes: Futures only, a small slice of the FX market. Positions as of Tuesday, released Friday.

relevance.reason: Free weekly positioning data for currency futures, a possible sentiment signal.
